title: Buyer
description: An overseas K-Beauty buyer candidate (distributor / importer / wholesaler / retailer / brand / marketplace). PRD 7.1 + 6.3 (Buyer Qualification Score) + 8 (state machine) + 13.2 (merge by canonical domain). Validated in two profiles: profile=raw (discovery output, score_version may be "unscored") and profile=scored (score_buyer.py output). See BUILD-CONTRACT.md sections 3, 5, 7.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema contract, e.g. "0.1.0".

buyer_id.description: Stable id for this buyer entity. Recommended form: BUY-<slug of canonical_domain> or the TradeWith lead id.

company_name.description: Company name exactly as printed on the most authoritative source. Korean gloss: 회사명 (출처 표기 그대로).

normalized_name.description: Output of _common.normalize_name(company_name): NFKC + casefold + legal-suffix stripped. Used as the fallback dedupe key. BUILD-CONTRACT.md 8.3.

canonical_domain.description: Registrable domain derived from website by _common.canonical_domain() (scheme/www/port/path stripped, NFKC+casefold, multi-part TLD aware). PRIMARY merge key per PRD 13.2 and test T06. "unknown" only when the company has no discoverable website; such records can never be auto-merged by domain. Korean gloss: 정규화 도메인 (병합 기준 키).

country_name.description: Human display name for country, e.g. "United Arab Emirates". Never used for matching; matching always uses the ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code in `country`.

company_type.description: PRD 7.1 company_type enum, plus "unknown" (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.4: "other" means "classified, none of the above"; "unknown" means "not yet determined" and triggers the unknown penalty). Korean gloss: 회사 유형.

product_categories.description: Canonical category slugs the buyer demonstrably handles (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 8.5 vocabulary). Absent = not yet determined (unknown). Present-and-empty = verified that no beauty category is handled (test T09).

korean_products_signal.description: Does the buyer demonstrably carry Korean / K-Beauty products? PRD 7.1. true|false|"unknown". Never infer false from absence of mention; absence is "unknown" (PRD 19 Unknown values).

korean_brands_carried.description: Named Korean brands evidenced on the buyer's own channels. Absent = unknown. Present-and-empty = checked, none found.

wholesale_signal.description: Does the buyer sell B2B / wholesale (wholesale page, MOQ terms, trade account, reseller pricing)? true|false|"unknown".

partnership_signal.description: Does the buyer publicly invite brand partnerships / distribution proposals? true|false|"unknown". The bare boolean is never scored positively: no sourcing_intent criterion reads it, because an invitation that is real produces an observable page and is credited through the B-SI2 signals that page emits (partnership_page, brand_submission_form, become_a_distributor_page). It reaches the score in one direction only, through the sourcing_intent adjustment partnership_signal_false, which prices a publicly CLOSED partnership channel.

buyer_moq.$comment: The unit lives in the sibling `buyer_moq_unit` and the currency, when the minimum is stated as money rather than pieces, in `buyer_moq_currency`. numeric_range.unit MAY appear here (the shared $defs allows it), but `buyer_moq_unit` WINS when both are present and a note is recorded; when only buyer_moq.unit is present it is copied into buyer_moq_unit during normalization. This mirrors seller.moq / seller.moq_unit exactly (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.3) so the two sides of a trade are stored in one shape. Never compare on buyer_moq.unit directly, and never compare a buyer minimum against a seller minimum whose unit or currency differs.
buyer_moq.description: The buyer's OWN published minimum order for a purchase order it places or accepts. number | {min,max} | "unknown". Absent or "unknown" means not published and takes the unknown path; it never causes a rejection. Real B2B sites publish this constantly and it is the single most material term a Korean seller needs, in three shapes the field must hold: a per-PO money floor ("10,000 AED per Purchase Order", "a minimum goods value of 5,000 USD" - set buyer_moq_currency), a per-line piece count ("12 pieces per line" - set buyer_moq_unit) and a plain unit count. A vague "low MOQs" is marketing, not a number: leave the field unknown and put the phrase in notes[]. Evidence items supporting it carry claim "buyer_moq". Scored by B-CR2 (published_minimum_order) and, when the buyer publishes the term as a supplier-facing condition, by B-SI2 (published_trade_terms).

buyer_moq_unit.description: Unit for buyer_moq, default "units". Authoritative over a unit carried inside buyer_moq itself; when only buyer_moq.unit is present it is copied here during normalization and a note is recorded. Use the unit the buyer printed, e.g. "units", "pieces_per_line", "skus". When the minimum is stated as money the unit is the currency's minor concept and buyer_moq_currency carries the code.

buyer_moq_currency.description: ISO-4217 alpha-3 code, upper case, when buyer_moq is a MONEY floor rather than a piece count (AED, USD, EUR, KRW). Absent means buyer_moq is a quantity. A money minimum and a quantity minimum are never compared to each other and never converted between currencies: no exchange rate is available to this package and inventing one would be a fabricated term.

sourcing_intent.description: PRD 7.1 sourcing_intent, plus "unknown". high = active, dated public sourcing action (open call, RFQ, "now accepting new brands"). medium = standing partnership/wholesale page with no dated activity. low = B2B capable but no sourcing invitation. unknown = not determined. Scoring rule BUILD-CONTRACT.md 5.2.C3.

sourcing_signals.description: Distinct evidenced sourcing signals. Absent = unknown. Present-and-empty = checked, none found. Each entry must be backed by at least one evidence item (INV-01). Every value here is priced by criterion B-SI2 in scoring.config.json under the identical key, so the two lists are one vocabulary: a value added here without a B-SI2 entry is unscorable. published_trade_terms covers a buyer that publishes the commercial terms on which it takes supply - a stated minimum order (store the number in buyer_moq as well), a trade price list, or trade-only pricing behind an approval gate - which is the supplier-facing signal real B2B importers emit far more often than a brand-intake page.

channels.description: Sales channels the buyer operates. Scored by criteria B-MR3 (channel match against query.channels, incl. channel_partial_match via scoring.config.json channel_adjacency) and B-CR3 (distributor_network_operated). Absent = unknown; present-and-empty = checked, none found.

contact_channels.description: Official company-level contact channels only. PRD 11.1/11.3: never store inferred personal emails or phone numbers. Absent = unknown (reachability criterion takes the unknown penalty). Present-and-empty = verified that no public channel exists (scores 0).

stale.description: Site unreachable / archived / clearly outdated (PRD EVID-04, test T07). Applies the stale penalty to evidence_quality and multiplies confidence. Default false.

operational_status.description: Evidenced business status. "closed" or "unreachable" excludes the record from outreach but never fabricates other field values.

qualification_score.description: PRD 6.3 Buyer Qualification Score, integer 0..100. BUILD-CONTRACT.md 5.2. When score_version == "unscored" this MUST be 0 and carries no meaning.

dimension_scores.description: The PRD 6.3 buyer dimensions, each an integer 0..100. Required in profile=scored, EXCEPT market_relevance: all three of its criteria carry an inapplicable_when condition, so a run whose query names no country, no product category and no channel drops the dimension entirely rather than scoring it 0. qualification_score == round_half_up(sum(weight_d * score_d for APPLICABLE d) / sum(weight_d for applicable d) * 100); with every dimension applicable that is the familiar (20*kbeauty_fit + 20*b2b_role + 25*sourcing_intent + 15*market_relevance + 10*reachability + 10*evidence_quality)/100. Renormalising over the applicable weights is what the config's INAPPLICABLE rule requires (a criterion - and by extension a wholly inapplicable dimension - leaves BOTH the numerator and the denominator); counting a dropped dimension as 0 in a fixed /100 denominator docked every candidate a flat 15 points on a no-query run.

dimension_details.description: Per-criterion audit trail, emitted by score_buyer.py so a human can reconstruct every point. PRD 6.3 ("점수와 함께 계산 근거를 노출한다").

unknown_penalty_applied.description: Every criterion whose inputs were all unknown, with the neutral-base + penalty arithmetic that was applied instead of a zero. PRD 6.4.4 and test T04.

qualified.description: qualification_score >= the effective threshold resolved by scoring.config.json qualification_threshold. Emitted by score_buyer.py.

evidence.description: Evidence backing the material claims on this record. Embedded by value. Every non-"unknown" material field must be covered by at least one evidence item whose `claim` is that field's canonical claim key (INV-01).

conflicts.description: Fields where two sources disagreed, plus how the disagreement was resolved (PRD test T08: official/most-recent wins, conflict note is kept).

missing.description: Human-readable labels of the facts still to confirm, rendered on the "Missing:" / "확인 필요" line of PRD 12.1 output. The de-duplicated unknown_penalty_applied labels first, then the scoring.config.json verification_gaps that apply to this record; BUILD-CONTRACT.md 5.1, 10.1.

merged_from.description: buyer_id values folded into this record by dedupe_companies.py (PRD DISC-04, test T06).

alias_domains.description: Other domains observed for the same entity (www/non-www variants, local-language domains) that resolved to this canonical_domain.

source_query.description: Echo of the discovery query that produced this candidate, so market_relevance is auditable.

category_drift.description: True when the agent had to widen the query and the result may sit outside the requested category (PRD DISC-05).

as_of.description: The --as-of date the score was computed against. Recency buckets are measured against this date only; scripts never read the wall clock (PRD 14 Determinism).

notes.description: Operator-facing notes. Inference, caveats and "확인 필요" flags go here, never into evidence quotes.

extensions.description: Escape hatch for runtime- or tenant-specific fields. Never read by any scoring script; never rendered in output.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: A single atomic, source-backed claim about a company, RFQ or market fact. PRD 7.4 + 10.3 (source priority) + EVID-01..EVID-05. Evidence objects are embedded by value inside buyer/seller/rfq/match-result documents; evidence_id is unique within the enclosing document.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema contract, e.g. "0.1.0".

evidence_id.description: Stable id, unique within the enclosing document. Recommended form: EV-<zero padded counter>, e.g. "EV-001".

claim.description: Canonical claim key this evidence supports. Use a key from BUILD-CONTRACT.md section 4.6 (canonical claim keys) whenever one applies, e.g. "korean_products_signal", "moq", "certifications", "oem_odm". Free text is allowed only for claims that have no canonical key. Korean gloss: 이 근거가 뒷받침하는 주장 키.

value.description: The observed value for the claim, exactly as normalized into the parent record. Arrays are allowed for list-valued claims such as certifications. "unknown" is allowed when the source explicitly states the value is undisclosed.

source_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL that a human can click to re-verify the claim. No login-walled, CAPTCHA-bypassed or paywalled URLs (PRD 11.1).

source_domain.description: Canonical registrable domain of source_url, derived by _common.canonical_domain(). Used for the independent-source count in the evidence-quality sub-score.

source_type.description: PRD 7.4 source_type enum, plus "internal_record" for facts read out of TradeWith's own database via adapters/tradewith_adapter.py (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 4.7).

source_tier.description: PRD 10.3 source priority tier. 1 = company official site / official contact-wholesale-export-OEM page. 2 = official trade-show, association, government or trade-agency directory. 3 = official LinkedIn or company social profile. 4 = reputable third-party directory or press release. 5 = community, blog, forum (supporting signal only). Korean gloss: 출처 우선순위 등급. internal_record defaults to tier 2.

is_official.description: True only when the claim was read on a channel the company itself controls (own domain, own verified social profile, own exhibitor entry). PRD EVID-02.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the agent read the page. This is OUR observation time, never the page's own date.

source_date.description: Date the source content itself was published or last updated. "unknown" when the page exposes no date. Never guess. Korean gloss: 출처 자체의 작성/갱신일.

confidence.description: How strongly this single source supports the claim, 0..1, two decimal places.

quote_or_summary.description: Verbatim quote (preferred, <= 300 chars) or a faithful one-sentence summary of the passage that supports the claim. Must not contain inference.

inferred.description: True when the value was derived by reasoning rather than read literally. PRD EVID-03 requires fact and inference to be separated. Default false.

stale.description: True when the source is unreachable, archived, or clearly outdated (PRD EVID-04, test T07). Triggers the stale penalty in the evidence-quality sub-score.

conflicts_with.description: evidence_id values in the same document that assert a contradictory value for the same claim (PRD test T08). Non-empty triggers the conflict penalty and requires a conflict note on the parent record.

retrieval_method.description: How the page was retrieved. Only non-bypassing methods are permitted (PRD 11.1).

notes.description: Free-form operator notes about this single evidence item.

quantity_value.description: A quantity: a non-negative number, an inclusive {min,max} range, or the literal "unknown". BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.3 normal form; _common.coerce_range() turns every non-unknown spelling into {"min": m, "max": M}.

tri_state.description: A tri-state fact: true, false, or the literal "unknown". BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.2 - absence and "unknown" both mean "not yet determined" and take the neutral-base penalty; false means "checked, demonstrably not the case" and scores as a real negative. Never write false for absence.

country_code.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, upper case, or the literal "unknown" (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.7, 8.7). "unknown" is a legal value and takes the unknown path; it never causes a hard-filter rejection.

category_list.description: Canonical product-category slugs from the BUILD-CONTRACT.md 8.5 vocabulary. A well-formed but unmapped slug is preserved verbatim with a note and matches only exactly (INV-33). Absent = unknown; present-and-empty = checked, none found.

score_0_100.description: A deterministic score, integer 0..100, rounded half-up (scoring.config.json determinism.rounding).

confidence_value.description: How much the reviewer should trust this record, 0..1, two decimal places. Driven by evidence quality, coverage, staleness and unresolved conflicts; never by the score itself.

score_version.description: Identifier of the scoring rubric that produced every number on this record, e.g. "kbtm-score-0.1.0" (scoring.config.json score_version). The literal "unscored" marks the raw discovery profile, in which qualification_score MUST be 0 and dimension_scores is absent (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.1, INV-23). A match-result document never carries "unscored".

entity_status.description: PRD 8 state machine. A seller inside a match run is normally MATCH_CANDIDATE, or READY_FOR_REVIEW once an outreach draft exists. The skill's own responsibility ends at READY_FOR_REVIEW; later states are owned by the TradeWith/CRM layer.

contact_channel.description: One official, company-level contact channel (BUILD-CONTRACT.md 3.6). Named individuals' addresses, direct-dial numbers, personal social handles and any pattern-guessed address MUST NOT be stored here or anywhere else (PRD 11.3, INV-11, INV-31).

type.description: Channel type, aligned with the B-RE1 signal keys in scoring.config.json. Korean gloss: 연락 채널 유형.

value.description: An absolute URL for the form/page/profile types, a role address on the company domain for corporate_email, or the company switchboard number as published for phone.

label.description: Optional display label as printed by the company, e.g. "Brand Partnership". Never a person's name or job title.

unknown_penalty.description: One criterion whose deciding inputs were all unknown. PRD 6.4.4 / test T04: unknown is neither a zero nor a rejection. The criterion receives round_half_up(criterion_max_points * (neutral_base / 100) * penalty_factor) instead of its full points, and the fact is surfaced to the reviewer as "확인 필요". Shape is shared with buyer.schema.json and seller.schema.json.

dimension.description: Dimension key the criterion belongs to, e.g. "operation_fit" on a match result or "operational_fit" on a seller record.

label.description: Human-readable criterion label, reused verbatim on the "Missing:" / "확인 필요" line.

unknown_inputs.description: Dotted field paths that were unknown or absent, e.g. ["seller.moq"].

neutral_base.description: scoring.config.json unknown.neutral_base (50): the neutral midpoint an unknown criterion starts from instead of 0.

penalty_factor.description: scoring.config.json unknown.penalty_factor (0.6): how much of the neutral base survives the penalty.

applied_points.description: round_half_up(criterion_max_points * (neutral_base / 100) * penalty_factor). Example: a 55-point criterion yields round_half_up(55 * 0.5 * 0.6) = round_half_up(16.5) = 17.

note.description: Optional clarification, e.g. "MOQ not published; hard filter HF-03 skipped."

dimension_detail.description: Per-criterion audit trail for one scored criterion, so a human can reconstruct every point (PRD 6.3). Shape is shared with buyer.schema.json and seller.schema.json.

earned_points.description: Points actually credited, after the criterion's aggregation rule and after any unknown penalty. May be 0.

signals_fired.description: Exact signal keys from scoring.config.json that fired for this criterion, e.g. ["moq_at_or_below_max"].

state.description: "scored" = inputs known. "unknown" = all deciding inputs unknown, neutral-base penalty applied. "inapplicable" = the RFQ imposes no such constraint, so the criterion is dropped from the dimension denominator and renormalised.

conflict.description: One field where two sources disagreed, and how the disagreement was resolved (PRD test T08, BUILD-CONTRACT.md 4.8). Both evidence items are kept and cross-linked via evidence.conflicts_with; the losing value is preserved here and never silently dropped. A conflict recorded here is RESOLVED and costs no evidence-quality points.

field.description: Canonical claim key / field name the two sources disagreed on, e.g. "moq".

winning_value.description: The value that was written into the record.

losing_value.description: The value that lost. Preserved so the operator can re-open the decision.

resolution.description: Which BUILD-CONTRACT.md 4.8 tie-break decided it, in order: official_source, then more_recent, then higher_confidence; manual = an operator decided.

evidence_id_list.description: evidence_id values resolvable in the enclosing document's `evidence` array (INV-22). Ids are never invented: an empty list means "no source backs this statement" and must be rendered as such.

points_0_100.description: A point value on the 0..100 scale that may carry decimals (weighted contributions, criterion points). Rounded to determinism.decimal_places.weighted_contributions.
